QUOTE: "`scope.not_indexed` lists extensions that exist in the tree but were never indexed. Here that is `.rs=2`, `.toml=2`, `.lock=1`, `.sql=1`, `.csv=3`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names file types that were NOT indexed (out of scope). The item requires naming file types that WERE in scope and produced no rows. It gives `scope` with indexed extensions, but never says that those in-scope types yielded zero rows.
